howto: Pick your age band, a mode (Math or Spelling) and a map, then Defend the Castle.
Choose a tower on the right (Arrow, Cannon or Frost) and tap a grass square beside the path.
Press START to send a wave; answer the Command Panel question at the bottom.
A right answer OVERCHARGES every tower; a wrong one makes them sputter and shows a hint.
Survive ten waves to win up to three stars.
tips: HINT (H) teaches the step for the question in front of you: make a ten, count up on a number line, skip-count, or read the sentence with each word in the gap.
When a purple Quiz Golem marches, arm the pedestal (A to D) that matches the right answer to double its loot.
Frost towers slow runners, cannons splash groups at the bends, arrows are cheap and fast.
Tap a tower to upgrade it or sell it for 60% back.
A Focus Token from the armory turns one wrong answer into an overcharge.

controls.keyboard: Mouse: click a tower card, then a grass square; Space starts a wave; 1 to 4 answer the Command Panel; H shows a hint; on the menu Enter starts, 1/2 pick the mode, M the map, B the age band; P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap a tower card, then a grass square; tap an answer; HINT sits bottom right. Hold the phone sideways (upright play is optional).

difficulty: Three age bands (5–7, 7–9, 9–11). Each band has its own range of question tiers, and the questions step up inside that range as the waves go on (every three waves in Math, every two in Spelling); enemies grow tougher each wave.

features.age-or-level-bands: Ages 5–7 / 7–9 / 9–11 buttons on the menu; waves ramp the tier inside the band
features.hints: HINT button in the sidebar (H, or the arcade Hint): a teaching nudge for the current question; a wrong answer also shows one in the Command Panel
features.grown-up-progress-report: FOR GROWN-UPS on the menu (all time) and on the victory or game-over screen (this game): skills practised, accuracy, words to practise and what to practise next
features.tutorial: How to Defend coach on the first game (build, start a wave, answer, golems); skip it or replay it from the menu
features.results: Victory screen with 1 to 3 stars, or Game Over, with waves survived, kills, career record and this game's accuracy
